span.p:
Authorizing template renders a neutral
spinner INSIDE MainLayout — prevents
login/nav layout flash while /auth/me
is in flight.

span.p:
Rendered by AuthorizeRouteView.NotAuthorized —
already inside DefaultLayout; a second
LayoutView here would double-nest the nav
(documented mitigation in App.razor).
Dev shows Microsoft + Guest; Prod Microsoft only.

span.p:
Cookie expiry mid-session — any API call
returns 401 JSON (never 302); provider
re-probes /auth/me and AuthorizeRouteView
swaps to Login without a full reload.
